messages:
pagerbot: ALERT: PagerDuty escalation -> sustained 5xx spike on inference-gateway-prod-usw2. 5m error rate 18% (route: /v1/generate). Auto-page to oncall@sre.
jordan: ack @pagerbot — i'm oncall. checking logs and routing.
sarah: seeing lots of 503 + kv timeouts: `kv get shard-12: context deadline exceeded` across many requests.
sarah: ratio of retries->5xx looks high, maybe client retry storm.
leo: quick check — health of inference pool looks ok but tail latencies are high. I can scale the pool by +2 replicas if we want.
jordan: action plan: 1) bump edge timeout 10s->20s, 2) scale inference-pool-usw2 +2, 3) disable LB retries for /v1/generate, 4) fallback small pct to quantized-model-v2 for non-critical traffic. If no improvement in 10m, escalate.
leo: running scale now: `terraform apply -target=module.inference_pool.usw2` — will post run id.
ops-bot: Action started: scale request submitted for inference-pool-usw2 (run id: tf-run-8734).
sarah: logs show a large batch job from acct: acme-corp around 09:12 EST, sending many concurrent requests.
maria-cs: pinging ACME support now to ask them to throttle.
jordan: disabling retries at LB for route to avoid amplification.
ops-bot: Action completed: LB retries disabled for /v1/generate (flag: retries=false).
leo: cache warming script queued to prefetch hot KV keys: `./scripts/warm_kv.sh hot_keys.txt`
sarah: metric update: error rate down to 6% after scale + timeout bump. KV timeouts persist for one shard.
maria-cs: ACME responded — they confirm a misconfigured batch job, will throttle to 25% of previous concurrency.
jordan: good. marking customer impact = partial (some user requests failed / degraded latency).
sarah: plan to run targeted KV shard restart if errors don't clear in next 8m.
ops-bot: PD note: incident acknowledged by jordan. Escalation timer paused for 10m.
leo: taking over oncall handoff in 20m. leaving run notes in runbook. link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx
jordan: observed stabilization: error rate ~1.2% after 12m, latency returning to baseline.
sarah: starting short RCA doc and will attach logs + hot keys.
maria-cs: outreach complete — ACME will submit a follow-up after their fix.
jordan: thumbs up everyone. if anything regresses ping here. handing off to leo. :heart:
leo: on it — will monitor for next 30m and then close if stable.
ops-bot: Action summary posted to #incidents-postmortem queue (task id pm-4492).
sarah: closing loop in channel: error rate back to normal, partial customer impact confirmed, postmortem TODOs assigned.
jordan: thanks all :thumbsup:
